messages.author: 5da9c77a55fe2db6
messages.subject: node number
parts:
Dear Dr. Yu, 

For a given tree topology, I usually have to get branch parameters from different softwares including BEAST and HYPHY. 

One of the problem is that their node number are inconsistent that the fortified dataframe can not easily complied. 

I don't known if you have adressed this in one of your vignettes? 

If not, do you have any hint on how to complie tree parameters with different node numbers from two or more trees (with the same topology)? 


Many thanks,
Yao

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: node number
parts: provided that the tree have identical topology, you can use merge_tree function.
